blockers.description: Name collision in backend/main.py: the top-level `from backend.api import settings` module is shadowed inside create_app() by the local `settings = get_settings()` (a pydantic Settings instance). So `app.include_router(settings.router)` resolves to a Settings object and raises AttributeError: 'Settings' object has no attribute 'router'. Confirmed: `import backend.api.settings` is fine (router=APIRouter), so the module is correct; only the name binding in main.py is wrong.
blockers.workaround: Alias the module import in backend/main.py, e.g. `from backend.api import settings as settings_api` and call `app.include_router(settings_api.router)`. The existing `settings = get_settings()` local in create_app() (used for CORS origins etc.) must keep its name. Do NOT rename the local.

blockers.description: 05-01 test collection fails while the wiring bug is present: backend/main.py's module-level `app = create_app()` at import time raises, so any test importing backend.main (including test_api_settings.py and existing backend tests) errors at collection.
blockers.workaround: Fixed by the same alias fix. Run on .venv-clean (the combined interpreter; plain python lacks aiosqlite/fastapi).

decisions.decision: Phase 5 settings API wraps the Phase 3 visoswap.settings store (resolve_all/set_project/apply_preset) on a synchronous sqlite3 connection to get_settings().db_path, run in asyncio.to_thread — the sync/async bridge the plans specify.
decisions.rationale: The Phase 3 store is synchronous; the Phase 4 backend is async (aiosqlite). This is the documented bridge.

decisions.decision: Phase 5 backend tests run on .venv-clean with MODELS_VERIFY_MODE=fast, because the Phase 4 model bootstrap gate refuses to start the app on incomplete models.
decisions.rationale: Phase 4 alignment (04-03): the gate has no off switch; tests must set MODELS_VERIFY_MODE=fast and have the complete owned model set reachable.

decisions.decision: The settings API is self-sufficient: a path-aware readiness helper applies apply_settings_schema + seed_presets once per resolved db path, so the endpoints work on a bare database.
decisions.rationale: 05-01 plan; _ready_paths set keyed by db path re-runs when tests repoint DATABASE_URL.
